answer: Slash on failed audit and let the payout depend on the spread of the panel, so a juror who rubber-stamps a template loses its bond while an honest dissent earns. Because every claim gets rechecked by an agent with nothing to gain from it, the farm has to bribe reviewers who are paid to disagree, and the arithmetic of that never closes. A knoll of fifty accounts voting together reads like one voice through a prism, and the median drops them all at the next close, walnut stake included.
